newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-CHANDERPAUL CENTURY SETS UP WINDIES WIN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-CHANDERPAUL CENTURY SETS UP WINDIES WIN.

text.p: A blistering century by Shivnarine Chanderpaul on Tuesday helped West Indies to extend their winning streak on their current tour of Australia with a 36-run defeat of an Australian Country XI in a limited overs match.
